name: 検索と保管を含む会話の受信一覧
prompt:
Create one finished Japanese conversation inbox screen in the same clean visual style as the correction target, with an aspect ratio matching exactly 390x590. This is a precise geometry correction, not a redesign. Use the native preview as the authority for layout, exact copy, typography and colors. Keep the entire current header/filter/archive block and all text unchanged. Keep the screen crop only: no status bar, phone frame or global bottom navigation.

Preserve exactly: centered 「会話」; rounded pale-gray search field with magnifier and 「会話を検索」; selected dark-green 「すべて」 with white text; pale-mint 「未読」 and 「お気に入り」 with dark-green text; gray archive icon and 「アーカイブ済み」; then these four conversation rows, each with mint initial avatar, dark bold name, right-aligned muted 「昨日」, muted preview and a fine divider:
1 「山田 はるか」 / 「みんなの予定を確認しています。」 / 「山」
2 「佐藤 ゆう」 / 「共有ありがとうございます。」 / 「佐」
3 「地域の仲間」 / 「参加について相談しましょう。」 / 「地」
4 「みんなの活動」 / 「新しいグループを作成しました。」 / 「み」

Change only the vertical placement and row pitch to match native logical coordinates on a 390x590 canvas: title begins near y14; search x16 y62 w358 h40; filters begin y120 and are about 32 high; archive text sits near y183; row avatar tops should be about y235, y322, y411 and y499; divider rules should be at y312, y400, y488 and y576. Keep the first row near its native y235 position and add enough vertical room to each successive row so the lower rows do not compress upward. The last row and final divider must reach the native lower positions with only the small native bottom inset. Keep avatar size about 52x51 and row text start x84. Do not scale the content down to create extra whitespace.

These are tappable conversation list rows, not inline hyperlinks. Keep names dark and previews muted gray; use no blue text because this screen contains no visible hyperlink text. Do not add unread badges, photos, additional rows, other text, or controls. Preserve crisp Meiryo-like Japanese type, restrained shadows, white background, and the native spacing. The native preview is authoritative; use v001 only as a visual correction target.
reviewNotes: 第2版を実画像で目視。会話見出し、検索、フィルター、アーカイブ行、4件の日本語会話を保持。表示テキストにリンクはなく青文字は追加していない。v001より会話行のピッチは広がり、行の上方圧縮は軽減。nativeの行上端は約y235/322/411/499、区切り線はy312/400/488/576。v002は目視で約y229/314/399/485、区切り線約y301/386/473/558となり、下段ほど上寄りが残る（最終線は約18px上）。2回の限定試行を保存し、needs-correctionのまま次IDへ進む。所有者受入・ネイティブ編集・実動作は未検証。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
